caption:
1) Transformer Fundamentals – Attention, encoder vs. decoder, tokenization, embeddings, positional encoding, and KV cache basics.

2) Autoregressive Decoding – Prefill vs. decode, causal attention, greedy search, beam search, top-k, top-p, temperature, and speculative decoding.

3) GPU & CUDA Basics – GPU architecture, CUDA kernels, memory hierarchy (HBM, SRAM, registers), kernel launches, tensor cores, and memory bandwidth.

4) PyTorch Execution

5) Model Compression – FP16, BF16, INT8, INT4, quantization, GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF, and KV cache quantization.

6) Serving Architecture – API servers, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, FastAPI, request lifecycle, batching, and streaming responses.

7) LLM Inference Engines – vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Hugging Face TGI, LMDeploy, llama.cpp, Ollama, and ONNX Runtime GenAI.

8) Scheduling –  batching, queues, paged attention, memory fragmentation, and KV cache management.

9) KV Cache Optimization – Prefix caching, LMCache, cache reuse, CPU/SSD offloading, disaggregated prefill, and cache eviction strategies.

10) Performance Metrics – TTFT, TPOT, throughput, latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, memory utilization, concurrency, and tail latency.

11) Distributed Inference 

12) Production Deployment – Autoscaling, load balancing, observability, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing, fault tolerance, and cost optimization.
